_doc: Which regions and provinces have their own voice lines. A region id listed in 'regions' needs the lang key society.nirncraft.say.region.<id> (the 'Tell me about this place.' answer); one in 'provinces' needs society.nirncraft.say.province.<id>. Lookup order: region, then province, then say.region.unknown. 'gossip' maps a region or province id to its number of three-line townsfolk chats society.nirncraft.chat.gossip_<id>.<0..n-1>.<0..2>. Region ids are the part of the regions.json id after the slash. Append only: lang files add the keys, no Java edit is needed.
